Select compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism. Filter molecule_dictionary to include the parent compound CHEMBL376359 and all related salts using molecule_hierarchy parent mapping. Join compound_records on molregno, join activities on record_id, and join docs on doc_id. Filter activities for standard_type IC50 and standard_units nM. Filter target_dictionary for ChEMBL ID CHEMBL284. Return all rows without limit.
